title: Parsing FASTA Files for Yersinia pestis Genome Analysis
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z9mf946

steps.title: Locate Y. pestis genome files
steps.instruction: Open a web browser and navigate to the NCBI FTP directory at ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCA/000/009/065/GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1 to view the available .gz files (e.g., .fna for nucleotide sequences, .faa for protein sequences).

steps.title: Download genome FASTA file
steps.instruction: In a terminal, run: wget ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCA/000/009/065/GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1/GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna.gz and verify the file appears with ls.

steps.title: Uncompress downloaded FASTA
steps.instruction: Decompress the file with: gunzip GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna.gz and confirm the resulting .fna file is present using ls.

steps.title: Verify FASTA formatting
steps.instruction: Display the first and last lines of the FASTA file to check format: head GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna && tail GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna. Header lines should start with ">" and sequence lines contain ATGC characters.

steps.title: View seqkit help for commands
steps.instruction: Consult seqkit documentation and help pages:

substeps.instruction: Open https://github.com/shenwei356/seqkit in a browser for general usage.
Run seqkit --help to list all sub‑commands.
Run seqkit stats --help to see options for the stats command.
Run seqkit fx2tab --help to see options for the fx2tab command.

steps.title: Obtain FASTA statistics
steps.instruction: Generate basic statistics for the gene set with: seqkit stats GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna.

steps.title: Show first ten gene entries
steps.instruction: Display a tabular view of the first ten genes using: seqkit fx2tab -a -i -g -l -n GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna | head.

steps.title: Sort genes by length
steps.instruction: List the ten longest genes by length with: seqkit fx2tab -a -i -g -l -n GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna | sort -r -n -k 2,2 | head.

steps.title: Sort genes by GC content
steps.instruction: List the ten genes with highest %GC using: seqkit fx2tab -H -a -i -g -l -n GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna | sort -rn -k 3,3 | head.

steps.title: Retrieve highest GC gene sequence
steps.instruction: Obtain the full DNA sequence of the gene with the highest %GC by running: seqkit fx2tab -H -a -i -g -l GCA_000009065.1_ASM906v1_cds_from_genomic.fna | head -n 1 (note the omission of the -n flag to include the sequence).
